svg.title: APEX 01 — APEX: from scattered know-how to proven capability
svg.text: APEX: from scattered know-how to proven capability
APEX is one secure, self-hosted front door to a firm’s solution portfolio, sales presentations and engineering
learning. We sell it as an annual organisation licence with an implementation package, entered through a paid pilot.

g.text: For engineering and technology-services organisations whose know-how lives in playbooks,
decks and blueprints, APEX is a self-hosted knowledge-to-capability platform that turns
scattered material into a searchable portfolio, a ready sales library and verified team capability
WHAT WE SELL, TO WHOM, AND WHY
One secure front door to an
package and a paid pilot as the entry
roles, audit, and data that never
PROBLEMS WE SOLVE · HOW WE DIFFER
Business problems that justify a purchase
Blueprints, decks and playbooks sit in shared folders: hard
to find, hard to present, and no one knows what is used.
Engineering playbooks are written once and rarely read;
there is no proof of who knows them or when they went out
TOO MANY TOOLS, TOO MANY LOGINS
Each tool has its own address and password; access, roles
and audit are inconsistent and hard to govern.
APEX builds courses from your own playbooks and
keeps them current; an LMS needs content made for it.
APEX makes material searchable, presentable and
measured, without moving it out of Dropbox.
APEX is self-hosted and joins sales content with
engineering capability in one front door.
APEX is built and tested today; a pilot runs in weeks
rather than a build taking quarters.

svg.text: Lead with the business problem — expertise trapped in people and folders — and position APEX as the
self-hosted way to make it findable, teachable and provable. Sell the pilot first; earn the licence with evidence.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
November 2026 · Internal sales enablement · A0 841 × 1189 mm
